**Follow the provided skill first** — Use the skill named `seo-local-business` as your primary workflow. Each skill has its own generation approach that produces higher-quality results. Leverage the skill's design system, templates, and rendering pipeline to maximize output quality.

# Fresh Pantry — Discover Everyday Deliciousness

## Overview

Build a single-page e-commerce landing site for **Fresh Pantry**, a neighborhood grocery brand that celebrates unique, high-quality food products at great prices. The audience is health-conscious grocery shoppers who love discovering new finds — think the excitement of wandering a well-curated store aisle, translated to the web. The tone should feel **warm, playful, and modern** — approachable but polished, never corporate or sterile.

## Visual & Style Direction

- **Color palette:** Think fresh greens, warm cream/off-white backgrounds, pops of sunny yellow or terracotta for accents. Avoid harsh neons or overly dark tones.
- **Typography:** A friendly rounded sans-serif for headings (something like Nunito or Poppins) paired with a clean body font. Keep it legible and inviting.
- **Imagery mood:** Bright, natural-light food photography vibes. Use placeholder images that suggest colorful produce, pantry staples, and cozy store interiors.
- **Layout:** Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, subtle shadows — the whole page should feel like a pleasant stroll through a sunlit market.

## Key Priorities

1. **The featured products carousel** is the centerpiece interaction — make sure the left/right navigation feels smooth and the product cards (with images, names, and prices) are visually appealing and easy to scan.
2. **The store locator** should feel functional and responsive: a zip code input with a search button that reveals mock store results. This drives the core business goal of in-store visits.
3. **Brand highlights stats** (500+ stores, 4,000+ products, etc.) should be presented as an eye-catching banner — use bold numbers with supporting labels to build credibility at a glance.
4. **Category hover effects** should feel delightful but not distracting — a gentle scale-up with an overlay is the target.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section list, all interaction specs, data display requirements, and navigation structure.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

# Fresh Pantry — Discover Everyday Deliciousness

## Brand

Fresh Pantry is your neighborhood grocery store reimagined — a place where quality meets affordability and every aisle holds a delicious surprise. We curate unique, hard-to-find food products alongside everyday essentials, all at prices that make you smile. Our mission is simple: make great food accessible to everyone, with a warm, welcoming shopping experience that feels like home.

Brand colors: #2D6A4F (primary forest green), #F4A261 (warm accent orange), #FEFAE0 (soft cream background)

## Hero Content

Title: "Discover Everyday Deliciousness"
Subtitle: "Unique flavors, quality ingredients, and unbeatable prices — all waiting for you at your neighborhood Fresh Pantry."
CTA: "Find a Store Near You" | "Explore This Week's Picks"

## Header Navigation

- Products
- Our Stores
- Recipes
- About Us

## Featured Products

A horizontally scrollable carousel of staff-favorite grocery items. Each card displays the product name, a short descriptor, and price.

| Product Name | Description | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Organic Maple Granola | Crunchy clusters with real maple syrup and toasted oats | $3.99 |
| Everything But The Bagel Seasoning | A savory blend of sesame, garlic, onion & poppy seeds | $2.49 |
| Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups | Rich dark chocolate with creamy peanut butter filling | $3.49 |
| Cauliflower Gnocchi | Light, pillowy gnocchi made with real cauliflower | $2.99 |
| Mandarin Orange Chicken | Crispy chicken bites in a sweet & tangy mandarin sauce | $4.99 |
| Unexpected Cheddar Cheese | Aged cheddar with crystalline crunch and complex flavor | $3.99 |
| Spicy Mango Lemonade | Tropical mango with a kick of chili and fresh lemon | $2.79 |
| Truffle Marcona Almonds | Roasted marcona almonds dusted with black truffle salt | $4.49 |

Interaction: Left/right arrow buttons slide the product cards horizontally to reveal additional items.

## Seasonal Picks

Title: "Summer Favorites Are Here 🌞"
Subtitle: "Limited-time flavors crafted for the season — grab them before they're gone!"

- **Watermelon Mint Sparkling Water** — Refreshing fizz with real watermelon essence and a hint of mint. $1.99
- **Grilled Peach & Burrata Salad Kit** — Everything you need for a summer salad in one box. $5.49
- **Coconut Cold Brew Concentrate** — Smooth, creamy cold brew with natural coconut flavor. $6.99
- **Mango Sticky Rice Spring Rolls** — A sweet twist on a classic, ready in minutes. $3.99

## Product Categories

A grid of category cards. On hover, each card scales up slightly and displays an overlay with the category name.

- **Snacks & Sweets** — Chips, cookies, trail mixes, and guilty pleasures
- **Fresh Produce** — Seasonal fruits, vegetables, and organic picks
- **Frozen Favorites** — Meals, appetizers, and desserts straight from the freezer
- **Beverages** — Juices, sparkling waters, coffees, and teas
- **Dairy & Cheese** — Artisan cheeses, yogurts, milk, and plant-based alternatives

## Brand Highlights

Key statistics displayed in a bold highlights banner across the page.

- **500+ Stores Nationwide** — From coast to coast, there's a Fresh Pantry near you
- **4,000+ Unique Products** — Curated items you won't find anywhere else
- **80% Private Label Items** — Our own brand means better quality at lower prices
- **New Items Every Week** — There's always something new to discover

## Store Locator

Title: "Find Your Fresh Pantry"
Subtitle: "Enter your zip code to discover the nearest store, hours, and directions."

Input placeholder: "Enter your zip code"
Button: "Search"

Sample results after search:

| Store Name | Address | Hours | Distance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fresh Pantry — Lincoln Park | 2140 N. Halsted St, Chicago, IL 60614 | 8am – 9pm Daily | 0.8 mi |
| Fresh Pantry — Wicker Park | 1840 W. North Ave, Chicago, IL 60622 | 8am – 9pm Daily | 1.4 mi |
| Fresh Pantry — Lakeview | 3745 N. Lincoln Ave, Chicago, IL 60613 | 8am – 9pm Daily | 2.1 mi |

## Newsletter

Title: "Stay Fresh 🍋"
Subtitle: "Sign up for weekly deals, new product alerts, and seasonal recipes delivered to your inbox."

Input placeholder: "Your email address"
Button: "Subscribe"
Confirmation message: "Thanks for subscribing! Check your inbox for a welcome treat."

## Footer Navigation

Shop: Products · Seasonal Picks · New Arrivals · Gift Cards
Company: About Us · Careers · Press · Sustainability
Help: Store Locator · FAQs · Contact Us · Accessibility

# Fresh Pantry — Discover Everyday Deliciousness

## Brand

Fresh Pantry is your neighborhood grocery store reimagined — a place where quality meets affordability and every aisle holds a delicious surprise. We curate unique, hard-to-find food products alongside everyday essentials, all at prices that make you smile. Our mission is simple: make great food accessible to everyone, with a warm, welcoming shopping experience that feels like home.

Brand colors: #2D6A4F (primary forest green), #F4A261 (warm accent orange), #FEFAE0 (soft cream background)

## Hero Content

Title: "Discover Everyday Deliciousness"
Subtitle: "Unique flavors, quality ingredients, and unbeatable prices — all waiting for you at your neighborhood Fresh Pantry."
CTA: "Find a Store Near You" | "Explore This Week's Picks"

## Header Navigation

- Products
- Our Stores
- Recipes
- About Us

## Featured Products

A horizontally scrollable carousel of staff-favorite grocery items. Each card displays the product name, a short descriptor, and price.

| Product Name | Description | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Organic Maple Granola | Crunchy clusters with real maple syrup and toasted oats | $3.99 |
| Everything But The Bagel Seasoning | A savory blend of sesame, garlic, onion & poppy seeds | $2.49 |
| Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups | Rich dark chocolate with creamy peanut butter filling | $3.49 |
| Cauliflower Gnocchi | Light, pillowy gnocchi made with real cauliflower | $2.99 |
| Mandarin Orange Chicken | Crispy chicken bites in a sweet & tangy mandarin sauce | $4.99 |
| Unexpected Cheddar Cheese | Aged cheddar with crystalline crunch and complex flavor | $3.99 |
| Spicy Mango Lemonade | Tropical mango with a kick of chili and fresh lemon | $2.79 |
| Truffle Marcona Almonds | Roasted marcona almonds dusted with black truffle salt | $4.49 |

Interaction: Left/right arrow buttons slide the product cards horizontally to reveal additional items.

## Seasonal Picks

Title: "Summer Favorites Are Here 🌞"
Subtitle: "Limited-time flavors crafted for the season — grab them before they're gone!"

- **Watermelon Mint Sparkling Water** — Refreshing fizz with real watermelon essence and a hint of mint. $1.99
- **Grilled Peach & Burrata Salad Kit** — Everything you need for a summer salad in one box. $5.49
- **Coconut Cold Brew Concentrate** — Smooth, creamy cold brew with natural coconut flavor. $6.99
- **Mango Sticky Rice Spring Rolls** — A sweet twist on a classic, ready in minutes. $3.99

## Product Categories

A grid of category cards. On hover, each card scales up slightly and displays an overlay with the category name.

- **Snacks & Sweets** — Chips, cookies, trail mixes, and guilty pleasures
- **Fresh Produce** — Seasonal fruits, vegetables, and organic picks
- **Frozen Favorites** — Meals, appetizers, and desserts straight from the freezer
- **Beverages** — Juices, sparkling waters, coffees, and teas
- **Dairy & Cheese** — Artisan cheeses, yogurts, milk, and plant-based alternatives

## Brand Highlights

Key statistics displayed in a bold highlights banner across the page.

- **500+ Stores Nationwide** — From coast to coast, there's a Fresh Pantry near you
- **4,000+ Unique Products** — Curated items you won't find anywhere else
- **80% Private Label Items** — Our own brand means better quality at lower prices
- **New Items Every Week** — There's always something new to discover

## Store Locator

Title: "Find Your Fresh Pantry"
Subtitle: "Enter your zip code to discover the nearest store, hours, and directions."

Input placeholder: "Enter your zip code"
Button: "Search"

Sample results after search:

| Store Name | Address | Hours | Distance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fresh Pantry — Lincoln Park | 2140 N. Halsted St, Chicago, IL 60614 | 8am – 9pm Daily | 0.8 mi |
| Fresh Pantry — Wicker Park | 1840 W. North Ave, Chicago, IL 60622 | 8am – 9pm Daily | 1.4 mi |
| Fresh Pantry — Lakeview | 3745 N. Lincoln Ave, Chicago, IL 60613 | 8am – 9pm Daily | 2.1 mi |

## Newsletter

Title: "Stay Fresh 🍋"
Subtitle: "Sign up for weekly deals, new product alerts, and seasonal recipes delivered to your inbox."

Input placeholder: "Your email address"
Button: "Subscribe"
Confirmation message: "Thanks for subscribing! Check your inbox for a welcome treat."

## Footer Navigation

Shop: Products · Seasonal Picks · New Arrivals · Gift Cards
Company: About Us · Careers · Press · Sustainability
Help: Store Locator · FAQs · Contact Us · Accessibility
Follow Us: Instagram · Facebook · Pinterest · TikTok

      --radius-xs:    8px;
      --radius-sm:    14px;

      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: 100px;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 14px 28px;
      font-size: 15px;
    }
    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--green-dark);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(45,106,79,.30);

    .btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }
    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--green);
      border: 2px solid var(--green);
      padding: 12px 26px;
      font-size: 15px;

      background: var(--green-pale);

      color: var(--white);
      padding: 14px 28px;
      font-size: 15px;
    }
    .btn-orange:hover {
      background: var(--orange-dark);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(244,162,97,.35);
    }
    .btn-lg { padding: 16px 36px; font-size: 16px; }
    .btn-sm { padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 13px; }

      display: inline-block;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      color: var(--green);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 12px;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto 56px;
    }
    .section-header h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .section-header p {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* ─── HEADER ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(254,250,224,.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .header.scrolled {
      border-color: rgba(45,106,79,.12);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(45,106,79,.10);
    }
    .nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      height: 72px;
      gap: 40px;
    }
    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .logo-icon {
      font-size: 26px;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .logo-text {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-dark);
    }
    .logo-text strong {
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 900;
    }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      flex: 1;
    }
    .nav-links li a {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      transition: color var(--transition), background var(--transition);
    }
    .nav-links li a:hover {
      color: var(--green);
      background: var(--green-pale);
    }
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 8px;
      margin-left: auto;
    }
    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--text-dark);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      background: var(--cream);
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(45,106,79,.10);
      padding: 16px 24px 24px;
    }
    .mobile-nav.open { display: block; }
    .mobile-nav ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
    .mobile-nav ul li a {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }
    .mobile-nav ul li a:hover { color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }

    /* ─── HERO ───────────────────────────────────────── */
    .hero {
      padding: 80px 0 96px;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cream) 0%, #F0F7EF 100%);
    }
    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -120px; right: -120px;
      width: 500px; height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(64,145,108,.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -80px; left: -80px;
      width: 380px; height: 380px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(244,162,97,.10) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero .container {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--green-pale);
      color: var(--green);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 7px 16px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 58px);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.1;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }
    .hero h1 em {
      font-style: normal;
      color: var(--green);
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero h1 em::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 2px; left: 0; right: 0;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--yellow);
      border-radius: 3px;
      z-index: -1;
      opacity: .5;
    }
    .hero-content > p {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      line-height: 1.75;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      max-width: 480px;
    }
    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .hero-stats {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .hero-stat {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
    }
    .hero-stat strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .hero-stat-divider {
      width: 1px;
      height: 32px;
      background: rgba(45,106,79,.20);
    }

    /* Hero Visual */
    .hero-visual {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .hero-food-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 380px;
    }
    .food-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 52px;
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      animation: float-gentle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .food-card:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; }
    .food-card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .5s; }
    .food-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 1s; }
    .food-card:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 1.5s; }
    .food-card:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 2s; }
    .food-card:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 2.5s; }
    .food-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.06);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    @keyframes float-gentle {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
    }

    /* ─── FEATURED PRODUCTS ──────────────────────────── */
    .featured-products {
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .carousel-viewport {
      flex: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }
    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      will-change: transform;
    }
    .product-card {
      flex: 0 0 calc(25% - 15px);
      background: var(--cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      border: 1.5px solid transparent;
    }
    .product-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: var(--green-pale);
    }
    .product-img {
      height: 160px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 64px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .product-body {
      padding: 16px 18px 20px;
    }
    .product-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .product-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .product-footer {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .product-price {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .product-add {
      width: 34px; height: 34px;
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 1;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .product-add:hover {
      background: var(--green-dark);
      transform: scale(1.1) rotate(90deg);
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 2px solid var(--green-pale);
      border-radius: 50%;
      font-size: 22px;
      color: var(--green);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      z-index: 2;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--green);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: scale(1.08);
    }
    .carousel-btn:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: not-allowed; }
    .carousel-dots {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }
    .carousel-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }
    .carousel-dot.active {
      background: var(--green);
      width: 24px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    /* ─── BRAND HIGHLIGHTS ───────────────────────────── */
    .highlights-banner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green-dark) 0%, var(--green) 100%);
      padding: 64px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .highlights-banner::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -100px; right: -100px;
      width: 400px; height: 400px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .highlights-banner::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -80px; left: -80px;
      width: 320px; height: 320px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .highlights-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .highlight-item {
      padding: 20px 24px;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .highlight-item:last-child { border-right: none; }
    .highlight-num {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--yellow);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .highlight-label {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .highlight-desc {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.68);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* ─── SEASONAL PICKS ─────────────────────────────── */
    .seasonal-picks {
      background: var(--cream);
    }
    .seasonal-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange), var(--yellow));
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 12px;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .seasonal-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .seasonal-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 28px;
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1.5px solid transparent;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }
    .seasonal-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: rgba(244,162,97,.25);
    }
    .seasonal-emoji {
      font-size: 48px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 72px; height: 72px;
      background: var(--cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .seasonal-info { flex: 1; }
    .seasonal-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      background: rgba(244,162,97,.15);
      color: var(--orange-dark);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .seasonal-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .seasonal-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .seasonal-price {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 20px;
      color: var(--orange-dark);
    }

    /* ─── CATEGORIES ─────────────────────────────────── */
    .categories {
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .categories-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .category-card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: .85;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .category-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
    .category-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }
    .category-card:hover .category-bg { transform: scale(1.07); }
    .category-emoji {
      font-size: 52px;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12));
    }
    .category-name-bg {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--white);
      text-align: center;
      text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
      padding: 0 12px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .category-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(45,106,79,.80);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
      backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
    }
    .category-card:hover .category-overlay { opacity: 1; }
    .category-overlay-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--white);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 14px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .category-overlay-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 14px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .category-overlay-btn {
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--green);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-top: 4px;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }
    .category-overlay-btn:hover {
      background: var(--yellow);
      color: var(--text-dark);
    }

    /* ─── STORE LOCATOR ──────────────────────────────── */
    .store-locator {
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #F0F7EF 0%, var(--cream) 100%);
    }
    .store-locator-inner {
      max-width: 680px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .store-search-box {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 36px;
      background: var(--white);
      padding: 8px 8px 8px 20px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .store-search-box:focus-within {
      border-color: var(--green);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), 0 0 0 4px rgba(45,106,79,.08);
    }
    .store-search-box input {
      flex: 1;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      background: transparent;
    }
    .store-search-box input::placeholder { color: var(--text-light); }
    .store-results {
      margin-top: 32px;
      display: none;
    }
    .store-results.visible { display: block; }
    .store-results-label {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .store-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 22px 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--green-pale);
      text-align: left;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      animation: slide-in .35s ease forwards;
      opacity: 0;
    }
    .store-card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .1s; }
    .store-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .2s; }
    @keyframes slide-in {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .store-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: var(--green);
      transform: translateX(4px);
    }
    .store-pin {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .store-info { flex: 1; }
    .store-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .store-address {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }
    .store-hours {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .store-dist {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      text-align: right;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .store-dist span {
      display: block;
      font-size: 20px;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    /* ─── NEWSLETTER ─────────────────────────────────── */
    .newsletter {
      background: var(--cream-dark);
    }
    .newsletter-inner {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .newsletter-inner h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .newsletter-inner p {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .newsletter-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      background: var(--white);
      padding: 8px 8px 8px 20px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
    }
    .newsletter-form:focus-within {
      border-color: var(--orange);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), 0 0 0 4px rgba(244,162,97,.10);
    }
    .newsletter-form input {
      flex: 1;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 15px;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-dark);
    }
    .newsletter-form input::placeholder { color: var(--text-light); }
    .newsletter-confirm {
      display: none;
      margin-top: 20px;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(45,106,79,.20);
      color: var(--green-dark);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      padding: 16px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      animation: slide-in .3s ease;
    }
    .newsletter-confirm.visible { display: block; }
    .newsletter-trust {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 24px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .trust-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
    }

    /* ─── Responsive ─────────────────────────────────── */

    @media (max-width: 768px) {

  <script>
    /* ── Header scroll shadow ─────────────────────────── */
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    }, { passive: true });

    /* ── Mobile nav ───────────────────────────────────── */
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
      mobileNav.setAttribute('aria-hidden', !open);
    });
    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        mobileNav.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      });
    });

    /* ── Product Carousel ─────────────────────────────── */
    const track       = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
    const prevBtn     = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    const nextBtn     = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
    const cards       = track.querySelectorAll('.product-card');
    const TOTAL       = cards.length;

    let visibleCount  = 4;
    let currentIndex  = 0;

    function getVisibleCount() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 480) return 1;
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return 2;
      if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) return 3;
      return 4;
    }

    function buildDots() {
      dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
      const pageCount = Math.ceil(TOTAL / visibleCount);
      for (let i = 0; i < pageCount; i++) {
        const dot = document.createElement('button');
        dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
        dot.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
        dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Page ${i + 1}`);
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i * visibleCount));
        dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
      }
    }

    function updateDots() {
      const dots = dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
      const activePage = Math.floor(currentIndex / visibleCount);
      dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === activePage));
    }

    function getCardWidth() {
      const card = cards[0];
      const gap = 20;
      return card.offsetWidth + gap;
    }

    function goTo(index) {
      const maxIndex = TOTAL - visibleCount;
      currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, maxIndex));
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${currentIndex * getCardWidth()}px)`;
      prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
      nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= maxIndex;
      updateDots();
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex - visibleCount));
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex + visibleCount));

    function initCarousel() {
      visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
      currentIndex = 0;
      track.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
      prevBtn.disabled = true;
      nextBtn.disabled = TOTAL <= visibleCount;
      buildDots();
    }

    let resizeTimer;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(initCarousel, 150);
    });

    initCarousel();

    /* ── Store Locator ────────────────────────────────── */
    function searchStores() {
      const zip = document.getElementById('zipInput').value.trim();
      const results = document.getElementById('storeResults');
      const btn = document.getElementById('storeSearchBtn');

      if (!zip) {
        document.getElementById('zipInput').focus();
        return;
      }

      btn.textContent = 'Searching…';
      btn.disabled = true;

      // Reset animation by re-inserting cards
      const storeCards = results.querySelectorAll('.store-card');

      setTimeout(() => {
        results.classList.add('visible');
        storeCards.forEach(card => {
          card.style.animation = 'none';
          void card.offsetWidth; // reflow
          card.style.animation = '';
        });
        btn.textContent = 'Search';
        btn.disabled = false;
        results.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
      }, 600);
    }

    document.getElementById('zipInput').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') searchStores();
    });

    /* ── Newsletter ───────────────────────────────────── */
    function subscribeNewsletter(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value.trim();
      if (!email) return;

      const form    = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
      const confirm = document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm');

      form.style.opacity = '0';
      form.style.transform = 'translateY(-8px)';
      form.style.transition = 'all .3s ease';

      setTimeout(() => {
        form.style.display = 'none';
        confirm.classList.add('visible');
      }, 300);
    }

    /* ── Category keyboard support ────────────────────── */
    document.querySelectorAll('.category-card').forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          card.querySelector('.category-overlay-btn')?.click();
        }
      });
    });

    /* ── Product add button animation ─────────────────── */
    document.querySelectorAll('.product-add').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        this.textContent = '✓';
        this.style.background = 'var(--teal)';
        setTimeout(() => {
          this.textContent = '+';
          this.style.background = 'var(--green)';
        }, 1500);
      });
    });
  </script>

</body>
</html>

    .food-card {

    .food-card:hover {

    @keyframes float-gentle {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
    }

    /* ─── FEATURED PRODUCTS ──────────────────────────── */
    .featured-products {
      background: var(--white);

    .carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;

    .carousel-viewport {
      flex: 1;
      overflow: hidden;

      display: flex;

      transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

    }
    .product-card {
      flex: 0 0 calc(25% - 15px);
      background: var(--cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);

    }
    .product-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: var(--green-pale);
    }
    .product-img {
      height: 160px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 64px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .product-body {
      padding: 16px 18px 20px;
    }
    .product-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .product-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .product-footer {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .product-price {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .product-add {
      width: 34px; height: 34px;
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 1;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .product-add:hover {
      background: var(--green-dark);
      transform: scale(1.1) rotate(90deg);
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 2px solid var(--green-pale);
      border-radius: 50%;
      font-size: 22px;
      color: var(--green);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      z-index: 2;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--green);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: scale(1.08);
    }
    .carousel-btn:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: not-allowed; }
    .carousel-dots {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }
    .carousel-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }
    .carousel-dot.active {
      background: var(--green);
      width: 24px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    /* ─── BRAND HIGHLIGHTS ───────────────────────────── */
    .highlights-banner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green-dark) 0%, var(--green) 100%);
      padding: 64px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .highlights-banner::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -100px; right: -100px;
      width: 400px; height: 400px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .highlights-banner::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -80px; left: -80px;
      width: 320px; height: 320px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .highlights-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .highlight-item {
      padding: 20px 24px;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .highlight-item:last-child { border-right: none; }
    .highlight-num {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--yellow);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .highlight-label {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .highlight-desc {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.68);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* ─── SEASONAL PICKS ─────────────────────────────── */
    .seasonal-picks {
      background: var(--cream);
    }
    .seasonal-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange), var(--yellow));
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 12px;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .seasonal-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .seasonal-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 28px;
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1.5px solid transparent;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }
    .seasonal-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: rgba(244,162,97,.25);
    }
    .seasonal-emoji {
      font-size: 48px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 72px; height: 72px;
      background: var(--cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .seasonal-info { flex: 1; }
    .seasonal-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      background: rgba(244,162,97,.15);
      color: var(--orange-dark);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .seasonal-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .seasonal-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .seasonal-price {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 20px;
      color: var(--orange-dark);
    }

    /* ─── CATEGORIES ─────────────────────────────────── */
    .categories {
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .categories-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .category-card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: .85;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .category-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
    .category-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }
    .category-card:hover .category-bg { transform: scale(1.07); }
    .category-emoji {
      font-size: 52px;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12));
    }
    .category-name-bg {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--white);
      text-align: center;
      text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
      padding: 0 12px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .category-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(45,106,79,.80);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
      backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
    }
    .category-card:hover .category-overlay { opacity: 1; }
    .category-overlay-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--white);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 14px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .category-overlay-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 14px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .category-overlay-btn {
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--green);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-top: 4px;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }
    .category-overlay-btn:hover {
      background: var(--yellow);
      color: var(--text-dark);
    }

    /* ─── STORE LOCATOR ──────────────────────────────── */
    .store-locator {
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #F0F7EF 0%, var(--cream) 100%);
    }
    .store-locator-inner {
      max-width: 680px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .store-search-box {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 36px;
      background: var(--white);
      padding: 8px 8px 8px 20px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .store-search-box:focus-within {
      border-color: var(--green);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), 0 0 0 4px rgba(45,106,79,.08);
    }
    .store-search-box input {
      flex: 1;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      background: transparent;
    }
    .store-search-box input::placeholder { color: var(--text-light); }
    .store-results {
      margin-top: 32px;
      display: none;
    }
    .store-results.visible { display: block; }
    .store-results-label {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .store-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 22px 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--green-pale);
      text-align: left;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      animation: slide-in .35s ease forwards;
      opacity: 0;
    }
    .store-card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .1s; }
    .store-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .2s; }
    @keyframes slide-in {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .store-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: var(--green);
      transform: translateX(4px);
    }
    .store-pin {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .store-info { flex: 1; }
    .store-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .store-address {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }
    .store-hours {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .store-dist {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      text-align: right;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .store-dist span {
      display: block;
      font-size: 20px;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    /* ─── NEWSLETTER ─────────────────────────────────── */
    .newsletter {
      background: var(--cream-dark);
    }
    .newsletter-inner {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .newsletter-inner h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .newsletter-inner p {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .newsletter-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      background: var(--white);
      padding: 8px 8px 8px 20px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
    }
    .newsletter-form:focus-within {
      border-color: var(--orange);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), 0 0 0 4px rgba(244,162,97,.10);
    }
    .newsletter-form input {
      flex: 1;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 15px;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-dark);
    }
    .newsletter-form input::placeholder { color: var(--text-light); }
    .newsletter-confirm {
      display: none;
      margin-top: 20px;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(45,106,79,.20);
      color: var(--green-dark);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      padding: 16px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      animation: slide-in .3s ease;
    }
    .newsletter-confirm.visible { display: block; }
    .newsletter-trust {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 24px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .trust-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
    }

    /* ─── FOOTER ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .footer {
      background: var(--green-dark);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.75);
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
    }
    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      padding-bottom: 48px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    }
    .footer-brand .logo-text {
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 22px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: block;
    }
    .footer-brand .logo-text strong { color: var(--yellow); }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.55);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      max-width: 260px;
    }
    .footer-socials {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .social-btn {
      width: 38px; height: 38px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.10);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 17px;
      transition: background var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
    }
    .social-btn:hover {
      background: var(--orange);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .footer-col h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }
    .footer-col ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .footer-col ul li a {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.60);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .footer-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--white); }
    .footer-bottom {
      padding-top: 28px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-copy {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.45);
    }
    .footer-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .footer-links a {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.45);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .footer-links a:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,.80); }

    /* ─── Responsive ─────────────────────────────────── */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 0; }
      .highlight-item { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
      .highlight-item:nth-child(2) { border-right: none; }
      .highlight-item:nth-child(3),
      .highlight-item:nth-child(4) { border-bottom: none; }
      .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .categories-grid .category-card:last-child { display: none; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 36px; }
      .product-card { flex: 0 0 calc(33.33% - 14px); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .section { padding: 60px 0; }
      .hero { padding: 48px 0 64px; }
      .hero .container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
      .hero-visual { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-food-grid { max-width: 280px; margin: 0 auto; }
      .food-card { font-size: 38px; }
      .nav-links, .nav > .btn { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .product-card { flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 10px); }
      .seasonal-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .categories-grid .category-card:last-child { display: block; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container { padding: 0 16px; }
      .hero h1 { font-size: 32px; }
      .hero-actions { flex-direction: column; }
      .hero-actions .btn { width: 100%; }
      .product-card { flex: 0 0 calc(80% - 10px); }
      .store-search-box { flex-direction: column; padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
      .store-search-box .btn { border-radius: var(--radius-sm); width: 100%; }
      .newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
      .newsletter-form .btn { border-radius: var(--radius-sm); width: 100%; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .carousel-btn { width: 36px; height: 36px; font-size: 18px; }
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .highlight-item { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
      .highlight-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- ══ HEADER ══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <header class="header" id="header">
    <div class="container">
      <nav class="nav">
        <a href="#" class="logo" aria-label="Fresh Pantry home">
          <span class="logo-icon">🌿</span>
          <span class="logo-text">Fresh<strong>Pantry</strong></span>
        </a>
        <ul class="nav-links">
          <li><a href="#featured-products">Products</a></li>
          <li><a href="#store-locator">Our Stores</a></li>
          <li><a href="#">Recipes</a></li>
          <li><a href="#">About Us</a></li>
        </ul>
        <a href="#store-locator" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">Find a Store</a>
        <button class="hamburger" id="hamburger" aria-label="Open menu" aria-expanded="false">
          <span></span><span></span><span></span>
        </button>
      </nav>
    </div>
    <div class="mobile-nav" id="mobileNav" aria-hidden="true">
      <ul>
        <li><a href="#featured-products">Products</a></li>
        <li><a href="#store-locator">Our Stores</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Recipes</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">About Us</a></li>
        <li><a href="#store-locator" style="color:var(--green);font-weight:800;">Find a Store Near You →</a></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- ══ HERO ════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <section class="hero" id="home">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="hero-content">
        <div class="hero-badge">🛒 500+ Stores Nationwide</div>
        <h1>Discover Everyday <em>Deliciousness</em></h1>
        <p>Unique flavors, quality ingredients, and unbeatable prices — all waiting for you at your neighborhood Fresh Pantry.</p>
        <div class="hero-actions">
          <a href="#store-locator" class="btn btn-primary btn-lg">Find a Store Near You</a>
          <a href="#featured-products" class="btn btn-outline btn-lg">Explore This Week's Picks</a>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-stats">
          <div class="hero-stat"><strong>500+</strong> Stores</div>
          <div class="hero-stat-divider"></div>
          <div class="hero-stat"><strong>4,000+</strong> Products</div>
          <div class="hero-stat-divider"></div>
          <div class="hero-stat"><strong>New finds</strong> every week</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-visual">
        <div class="hero-food-grid" role="img" aria-label="Colorful food illustration">
          <div class="food-card">🥑</div>
          <div class="food-card">🍊</div>
          <div class="food-card">🫐</div>
          <div class="food-card">🧀</div>
          <div class="food-card">🍃</div>
          <div class="food-card">🌽</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ══ FEATURED PRODUCTS ════════════════════════════════ -->
  <section class="section featured-products" id="featured-products">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-header">
        <div class="section-tag">Staff Favorites</div>
        <h2>This Week's Featured Finds</h2>
        <p>Handpicked by our team — unique, delicious, and priced to please your wallet.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="carousel-wrapper" role="region" aria-label="Featured products carousel">
        <button class="carousel-btn carousel-btn-left" id="carouselPrev" aria-label="Previous products" disabled>‹</button>
        <div class="carousel-viewport">
          <div class="carousel-track" id="carouselTrack">

            <!-- Card 1 -->
            <div class="product-card">
              <div class="product-img" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg,#FFF3E0,#FFE0B2);">🌾</div>
              <div class="product-body">
                <div class="product-name">Organic Maple Granola</div>

  <!-- ══ SCRIPTS ═══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <script>
    /* ── Header scroll shadow ─────────────────────────── */
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    }, { passive: true });

    /* ── Mobile nav ───────────────────────────────────── */
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
      mobileNav.setAttribute('aria-hidden', !open);
    });
    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        mobileNav.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      });
    });

    /* ── Product Carousel ─────────────────────────────── */
    const track       = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
    const prevBtn     = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    const nextBtn     = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
    const cards       = track.querySelectorAll('.product-card');
    const TOTAL       = cards.length;

    let visibleCount  = 4;
    let currentIndex  = 0;

    function getVisibleCount() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 480) return 1;
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return 2;
      if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) return 3;
      return 4;
    }

    function buildDots() {
      dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
      const pageCount = Math.ceil(TOTAL / visibleCount);
      for (let i = 0; i < pageCount; i++) {
        const dot = document.createElement('button');
        dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
        dot.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
        dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Page ${i + 1}`);
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i * visibleCount));
        dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
      }
    }

    function updateDots() {
      const dots = dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
      const activePage = Math.floor(currentIndex / visibleCount);
      dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === activePage));
    }

    function getCardWidth() {
      const card = cards[0];
      const gap = 20;
      return card.offsetWidth + gap;
    }

    function goTo(index) {
      const maxIndex = TOTAL - visibleCount;
      currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, maxIndex));
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${currentIndex * getCardWidth()}px)`;
      prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
      nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= maxIndex;
      updateDots();
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex - visibleCount));
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex + visibleCount));

    function initCarousel() {
      visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
      currentIndex = 0;
      track.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
      prevBtn.disabled = true;
      nextBtn.disabled = TOTAL <= visibleCount;
      buildDots();
    }

    let resizeTimer;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(initCarousel, 150);
    });

    initCarousel();

    /* ── Store Locator ────────────────────────────────── */
    function searchStores() {
      const zip = document.getElementById('zipInput').value.trim();
      const results = document.getElementById('storeResults');
      const btn = document.getElementById('storeSearchBtn');

      if (!zip) {
        document.getElementById('zipInput').focus();
        return;
      }

      btn.textContent = 'Searching…';
      btn.disabled = true;

      // Reset animation by re-inserting cards
      const storeCards = results.querySelectorAll('.store-card');

      setTimeout(() => {
        results.classList.add('visible');
        storeCards.forEach(card => {
          card.style.animation = 'none';
          void card.offsetWidth; // reflow
          card.style.animation = '';
        });
        btn.textContent = 'Search';
        btn.disabled = false;
        results.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
      }, 600);
    }

    document.getElementById('zipInput').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') searchStores();
    });

    /* ── Newsletter ───────────────────────────────────── */
    function subscribeNewsletter(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value.trim();
      if (!email) return;

      const form    = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
      const confirm = document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm');

      form.style.opacity = '0';
      form.style.transform = 'translateY(-8px)';
      form.style.transition = 'all .3s ease';

      setTimeout(() => {
        form.style.display = 'none';
        confirm.classList.add('visible');
      }, 300);
    }

    /* ── Category keyboard support ────────────────────── */
    document.querySelectorAll('.category-card').forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          card.querySelector('.category-overlay-btn')?.click();
        }
      });
    });

    /* ── Product add button animation ─────────────────── */
    document.querySelectorAll('.product-add').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        this.textContent = '✓';
        this.style.background = 'var(--teal)';
        setTimeout(() => {
          this.textContent = '+';
          this.style.background = 'var(--green)';
        }, 1500);
      });
    });
  </script>

  <style>
    /* ─── Design Tokens ─────────────────────────────── */
    :root {
      --green:        #2D6A4F;
      --green-light:  #40916C;
      --green-dark:   #1B4332;
      --green-pale:   #D8F3DC;
      --orange:       #F4A261;
      --orange-dark:  #E76F51;
      --cream:        #FEFAE0;
      --cream-dark:   #F5EFC8;
      --yellow:       #F9C74F;
      --terracotta:   #E07A5F;

      --text-light:   #7A9088;
      --white:        #FFFFFF;
      --shadow-sm:    0 2px 10px rgba(45,106,79,.10);
      --shadow-md:    0 6px 24px rgba(45,106,79,.14);
      --shadow-lg:    0 12px 48px rgba(45,106,79,.18);
      --shadow-xl:    0 20px 64px rgba(45,106,79,.22);

      --radius-xl:    40px;
      --font-head:    'Nunito', sans-serif;
      --font-body:    'Inter', sans-serif;
      --transition:   0.25s ease;
    }

    /* ─── Reset ──────────────────────────────────────── */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      background: var(--cream);

      line-height: 1.65;

    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    ul { list-style: none; }
    button { cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; font-family: inherit; }

    /* ─── Layout ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;

    .section {
      padding: 88px 0;

    /* ─── Buttons ────────────────────────────────────── */

      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: 100px;

    .hero h1 {

    .hero h1 em {

      content: '';
      position: absolute;

      border-radius: 3px;
      z-index: -1;
      opacity: .5;
    }
    .hero-content > p {

      line-height: 1.75;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      max-width: 480px;

    .hero-actions {

    .hero-stats {

    .hero-stat {

    .hero-stat-divider {

      height: 32px;
      background: rgba(45,106,79,.20);
    }

    /* Hero Visual */
    .hero-visual {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .hero-food-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 380px;

    .food-card {

      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      aspect-ratio: 1;

      align-items: center;

      animation: float-gentle 4s ease-in-out infinite;

    .food-card:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; }

    .food-card:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 1.5s; }
    .food-card:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 2s; }
    .food-card:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 2.5s; }

    .featured-products {

    .product-name {

    .carousel-btn {

    .carousel-dot.active {

    .highlights-banner {

      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), 0 0 0 4px rgba(45,106,79,.08);
    }

      border: none;
      outline: none;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      background: transparent;

    .store-results {
      margin-top: 32px;
      display: none;

      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-mid);

      margin-bottom: 16px;

    .store-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 22px 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--green-pale);
      text-align: left;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      animation: slide-in .35s ease forwards;
      opacity: 0;

    .store-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .2s; }

      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .store-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: var(--green);
      transform: translateX(4px);
    }
    .store-pin {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .store-info { flex: 1; }
    .store-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 3px;

      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-mid);

    .store-hours {

      color: var(--green);

    }
    .store-dist {

      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      text-align: right;

    /* ─── NEWSLETTER ─────────────────────────────────── */

      background: var(--cream-dark);
    }

      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto;

      font-size: 15px;

      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 24px;

      align-items: center;

      font-size: 13px;

    /* ─── FOOTER ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .footer {
      background: var(--green-dark);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.75);
      padding: 64px 0 32px;

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;

      gap: 48px;
      padding-bottom: 48px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);

      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: block;
    }

      color: rgba(255,255,255,.55);

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: .08em;

    .footer-col ul li a {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.60);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .footer-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--white); }
    .footer-bottom {
      padding-top: 28px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-copy {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.45);
    }
    .footer-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .footer-links a {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.45);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .footer-links a:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,.80); }

    /* ─── Responsive ─────────────────────────────────── */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 0; }
      .highlight-item { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
      .highlight-item:nth-child(2) { border-right: none; }
      .highlight-item:nth-child(3),
      .highlight-item:nth-child(4) { border-bottom: none; }
      .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .categories-grid .category-card:last-child { display: none; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 36px; }
      .product-card { flex: 0 0 calc(33.33% - 14px); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .section { padding: 60px 0; }
      .hero { padding: 48px 0 64px; }
      .hero .container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
      .hero-visual { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-food-grid { max-width: 280px; margin: 0 auto; }
      .food-card { font-size: 38px; }
      .nav-links, .nav > .btn { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .product-card { flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 10px); }
      .seasonal-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .categories-grid .category-card:last-child { display: block; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container { padding: 0 16px; }
      .hero h1 { font-size: 32px; }
      .hero-actions { flex-direction: column; }
      .hero-actions .btn { width: 100%; }
      .product-card { flex: 0 0 calc(80% - 10px); }
      .store-search-box { flex-direction: column; padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
      .store-search-box .btn { border-radius: var(--radius-sm); width: 100%; }
      .newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
      .newsletter-form .btn { border-radius: var(--radius-sm); width: 100%; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .carousel-btn { width: 36px; height: 36px; font-size: 18px; }
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .highlight-item { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
      .highlight-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

  <section class="section store-locator" id="store-locator">

  <section class="section newsletter" id="newsletter">

        <form class="newsletter-form" id="newsletterForm" onsubmit="subscribeNewsletter(event)">

  <!-- ══ FOOTER ════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

    <div class="container">

          <p class="footer-tagline" style="margin-top:14px;">Your neighborhood grocery reimagined — where quality meets affordability and every aisle holds a delicious surprise.</p>

        <div class="footer-col">
          <h4>Shop</h4>
          <ul>
            <li><a href="#featured-products">Products</a></li>
            <li><a href="#seasonal-picks">Seasonal Picks</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">New Arrivals</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Gift Cards</a></li>
          </ul>
        </div>

        <div class="footer-col">
          <h4>Company</h4>
          <ul>
            <li><a href="#">About Us</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Careers</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Press</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Sustainability</a></li>
