  <script>
    /* ── Header scroll shadow ─────────────────────────── */
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    }, { passive: true });

    /* ── Mobile nav ───────────────────────────────────── */
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
      mobileNav.setAttribute('aria-hidden', !open);
    });
    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        mobileNav.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      });
    });

    /* ── Product Carousel ─────────────────────────────── */
    const track       = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
    const prevBtn     = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    const nextBtn     = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
    const cards       = track.querySelectorAll('.product-card');
    const TOTAL       = cards.length;

    let visibleCount  = 4;
    let currentIndex  = 0;

    function getVisibleCount() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 480) return 1;
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return 2;
      if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) return 3;
      return 4;
    }

    function buildDots() {
      dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
      const pageCount = Math.ceil(TOTAL / visibleCount);
      for (let i = 0; i < pageCount; i++) {
        const dot = document.createElement('button');
        dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
        dot.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
        dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Page ${i + 1}`);
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i * visibleCount));
        dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
      }
    }

    function updateDots() {
      const dots = dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
      const activePage = Math.floor(currentIndex / visibleCount);
      dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === activePage));
    }

    function getCardWidth() {
      const card = cards[0];
      const gap = 20;
      return card.offsetWidth + gap;
    }

    function goTo(index) {
      const maxIndex = TOTAL - visibleCount;
      currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, maxIndex));
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${currentIndex * getCardWidth()}px)`;
      prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
      nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= maxIndex;
      updateDots();
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex - visibleCount));
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex + visibleCount));

    function initCarousel() {
      visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
      currentIndex = 0;
      track.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
      prevBtn.disabled = true;
      nextBtn.disabled = TOTAL <= visibleCount;
      buildDots();
    }

    let resizeTimer;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(initCarousel, 150);
    });

    initCarousel();

    /* ── Store Locator ────────────────────────────────── */
    function searchStores() {
      const zip = document.getElementById('zipInput').value.trim();
      const results = document.getElementById('storeResults');
      const btn = document.getElementById('storeSearchBtn');

      if (!zip) {
        document.getElementById('zipInput').focus();
        return;
      }

      btn.textContent = 'Searching…';
      btn.disabled = true;

      // Reset animation by re-inserting cards
      const storeCards = results.querySelectorAll('.store-card');

      setTimeout(() => {
        results.classList.add('visible');
        storeCards.forEach(card => {
          card.style.animation = 'none';
          void card.offsetWidth; // reflow
          card.style.animation = '';
        });
        btn.textContent = 'Search';
        btn.disabled = false;
        results.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
      }, 600);
    }

    document.getElementById('zipInput').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') searchStores();
    });

    /* ── Newsletter ───────────────────────────────────── */
    function subscribeNewsletter(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value.trim();
      if (!email) return;

      const form    = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
      const confirm = document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm');

      form.style.opacity = '0';
      form.style.transform = 'translateY(-8px)';
      form.style.transition = 'all .3s ease';

      setTimeout(() => {
        form.style.display = 'none';
        confirm.classList.add('visible');
      }, 300);
    }

    /* ── Category keyboard support ────────────────────── */
    document.querySelectorAll('.category-card').forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          card.querySelector('.category-overlay-btn')?.click();
        }
      });
    });

    /* ── Product add button animation ─────────────────── */
    document.querySelectorAll('.product-add').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        this.textContent = '✓';
        this.style.background = 'var(--teal)';
        setTimeout(() => {
          this.textContent = '+';
          this.style.background = 'var(--green)';
        }, 1500);
      });
    });
  </script>

</body>
</html>

    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      background: var(--cream);
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(45,106,79,.10);
      padding: 16px 24px 24px;
    }
    .mobile-nav.open { display: block; }
    .mobile-nav ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
    .mobile-nav ul li a {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }
    .mobile-nav ul li a:hover { color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }

    /* ─── HERO ───────────────────────────────────────── */
    .hero {
      padding: 80px 0 96px;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cream) 0%, #F0F7EF 100%);
    }
    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -120px; right: -120px;
      width: 500px; height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(64,145,108,.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -80px; left: -80px;
      width: 380px; height: 380px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(244,162,97,.10) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero .container {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--green-pale);
      color: var(--green);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 7px 16px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 58px);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.1;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }
    .hero h1 em {
      font-style: normal;
      color: var(--green);
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero h1 em::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 2px; left: 0; right: 0;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--yellow);
      border-radius: 3px;
      z-index: -1;
      opacity: .5;
    }
    .hero-content > p {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      line-height: 1.75;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      max-width: 480px;
    }
    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .hero-stats {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .hero-stat {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
    }
    .hero-stat strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .hero-stat-divider {
      width: 1px;
      height: 32px;
      background: rgba(45,106,79,.20);
    }

    /* Hero Visual */
    .hero-visual {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .hero-food-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 380px;
    }
    .food-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 52px;
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      animation: float-gentle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .food-card:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; }
    .food-card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .5s; }
    .food-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 1s; }
    .food-card:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 1.5s; }
    .food-card:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 2s; }
    .food-card:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 2.5s; }
    .food-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.06);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    @keyframes float-gentle {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
    }

    /* ─── FEATURED PRODUCTS ──────────────────────────── */
    .featured-products {
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .carousel-viewport {
      flex: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }
    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      will-change: transform;
    }
    .product-card {
      flex: 0 0 calc(25% - 15px);
      background: var(--cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      border: 1.5px solid transparent;
    }
    .product-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: var(--green-pale);
    }
    .product-img {
      height: 160px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 64px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .product-body {
      padding: 16px 18px 20px;
    }
    .product-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .product-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .product-footer {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .product-price {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .product-add {
      width: 34px; height: 34px;
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 1;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .product-add:hover {
      background: var(--green-dark);
      transform: scale(1.1) rotate(90deg);
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 2px solid var(--green-pale);
      border-radius: 50%;
      font-size: 22px;
      color: var(--green);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      z-index: 2;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--green);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: scale(1.08);
    }
    .carousel-btn:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: not-allowed; }
    .carousel-dots {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }
    .carousel-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }
    .carousel-dot.active {
      background: var(--green);
      width: 24px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    /* ─── BRAND HIGHLIGHTS ───────────────────────────── */
    .highlights-banner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green-dark) 0%, var(--green) 100%);
      padding: 64px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .highlights-banner::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -100px; right: -100px;
      width: 400px; height: 400px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .highlights-banner::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -80px; left: -80px;
      width: 320px; height: 320px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .highlights-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .highlight-item {
      padding: 20px 24px;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .highlight-item:last-child { border-right: none; }
    .highlight-num {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--yellow);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .highlight-label {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .highlight-desc {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.68);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* ─── SEASONAL PICKS ─────────────────────────────── */
    .seasonal-picks {
      background: var(--cream);
    }
    .seasonal-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange), var(--yellow));
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 12px;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .seasonal-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .seasonal-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 28px;
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1.5px solid transparent;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }
    .seasonal-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: rgba(244,162,97,.25);
    }
    .seasonal-emoji {
      font-size: 48px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 72px; height: 72px;
      background: var(--cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .seasonal-info { flex: 1; }
    .seasonal-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      background: rgba(244,162,97,.15);
      color: var(--orange-dark);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .seasonal-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .seasonal-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .seasonal-price {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 20px;
      color: var(--orange-dark);
    }

    /* ─── CATEGORIES ─────────────────────────────────── */
    .categories {
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .categories-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .category-card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: .85;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .category-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
    .category-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }
    .category-card:hover .category-bg { transform: scale(1.07); }
    .category-emoji {
      font-size: 52px;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12));
    }
    .category-name-bg {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--white);
      text-align: center;
      text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
      padding: 0 12px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .category-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(45,106,79,.80);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
      backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
    }
    .category-card:hover .category-overlay { opacity: 1; }
    .category-overlay-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--white);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 14px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .category-overlay-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 14px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .category-overlay-btn {
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--green);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-top: 4px;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }
    .category-overlay-btn:hover {
      background: var(--yellow);
      color: var(--text-dark);
    }

    /* ─── STORE LOCATOR ──────────────────────────────── */
    .store-locator {
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #F0F7EF 0%, var(--cream) 100%);
    }
    .store-locator-inner {
      max-width: 680px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .store-search-box {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 36px;
      background: var(--white);
      padding: 8px 8px 8px 20px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .store-search-box:focus-within {
      border-color: var(--green);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), 0 0 0 4px rgba(45,106,79,.08);
    }
    .store-search-box input {
      flex: 1;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      background: transparent;
    }
    .store-search-box input::placeholder { color: var(--text-light); }
    .store-results {
      margin-top: 32px;
      display: none;
    }
    .store-results.visible { display: block; }
    .store-results-label {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .store-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 22px 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--green-pale);
      text-align: left;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      animation: slide-in .35s ease forwards;
      opacity: 0;
    }
    .store-card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .1s; }
    .store-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .2s; }
    @keyframes slide-in {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .store-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: var(--green);
      transform: translateX(4px);
    }
    .store-pin {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .store-info { flex: 1; }
    .store-name {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .store-address {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }
    .store-hours {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .store-dist {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-light);
      text-align: right;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .store-dist span {
      display: block;
      font-size: 20px;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    /* ─── NEWSLETTER ─────────────────────────────────── */
    .newsletter {
      background: var(--cream-dark);
    }
    .newsletter-inner {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .newsletter-inner h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .newsletter-inner p {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .newsletter-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      background: var(--white);
      padding: 8px 8px 8px 20px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
    }
    .newsletter-form:focus-within {
      border-color: var(--orange);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), 0 0 0 4px rgba(244,162,97,.10);
    }
    .newsletter-form input {
      flex: 1;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 15px;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-dark);
    }
    .newsletter-form input::placeholder { color: var(--text-light); }
    .newsletter-confirm {
      display: none;
      margin-top: 20px;
      background: var(--green-pale);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(45,106,79,.20);
      color: var(--green-dark);
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      padding: 16px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      animation: slide-in .3s ease;
    }
    .newsletter-confirm.visible { display: block; }
    .newsletter-trust {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 24px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .trust-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-light);
    }

    /* ─── FOOTER ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .footer {
      background: var(--green-dark);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.75);
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
    }
    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      padding-bottom: 48px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    }
    .footer-brand .logo-text {
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 22px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: block;
    }
    .footer-brand .logo-text strong { color: var(--yellow); }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.55);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      max-width: 260px;
    }
    .footer-socials {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .social-btn {
      width: 38px; height: 38px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.10);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 17px;
      transition: background var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
    }
    .social-btn:hover {
      background: var(--orange);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .footer-col h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-head);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }
    .footer-col ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .footer-col ul li a {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.60);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .footer-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--white); }
    .footer-bottom {
      padding-top: 28px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-copy {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.45);
    }
    .footer-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .footer-links a {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.45);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .footer-links a:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,.80); }

    /* ─── Responsive ─────────────────────────────────── */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 0; }
      .highlight-item { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
      .highlight-item:nth-child(2) { border-right: none; }
      .highlight-item:nth-child(3),

  <script>
    /* ── Header scroll shadow ─────────────────────────── */
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    }, { passive: true });

    /* ── Mobile nav ───────────────────────────────────── */
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
      mobileNav.setAttribute('aria-hidden', !open);
    });
    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        mobileNav.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      });
    });

    /* ── Product Carousel ─────────────────────────────── */
    const track       = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
    const prevBtn     = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    const nextBtn     = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
    const cards       = track.querySelectorAll('.product-card');
    const TOTAL       = cards.length;

    let visibleCount  = 4;
    let currentIndex  = 0;

    function getVisibleCount() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 480) return 1;
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return 2;
      if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) return 3;
      return 4;
    }

    function buildDots() {
      dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
      const pageCount = Math.ceil(TOTAL / visibleCount);
      for (let i = 0; i < pageCount; i++) {
        const dot = document.createElement('button');
        dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
        dot.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
        dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Page ${i + 1}`);
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i * visibleCount));
        dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
      }
    }

    function updateDots() {
      const dots = dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
      const activePage = Math.floor(currentIndex / visibleCount);
      dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === activePage));
    }

    function getCardWidth() {
      const card = cards[0];
      const gap = 20;
      return card.offsetWidth + gap;
    }

    function goTo(index) {
      const maxIndex = TOTAL - visibleCount;
      currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, maxIndex));
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${currentIndex * getCardWidth()}px)`;
      prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
      nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= maxIndex;
      updateDots();
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex - visibleCount));
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(currentIndex + visibleCount));

    function initCarousel() {
      visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
      currentIndex = 0;
      track.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
      prevBtn.disabled = true;
      nextBtn.disabled = TOTAL <= visibleCount;
      buildDots();
    }

    let resizeTimer;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(initCarousel, 150);
    });

    initCarousel();

    /* ── Store Locator ────────────────────────────────── */
    function searchStores() {
      const zip = document.getElementById('zipInput').value.trim();
      const results = document.getElementById('storeResults');
      const btn = document.getElementById('storeSearchBtn');

      if (!zip) {
        document.getElementById('zipInput').focus();
        return;
      }

      btn.textContent = 'Searching…';
      btn.disabled = true;

      // Reset animation by re-inserting cards
      const storeCards = results.querySelectorAll('.store-card');

      setTimeout(() => {
        results.classList.add('visible');
        storeCards.forEach(card => {
          card.style.animation = 'none';
          void card.offsetWidth; // reflow
          card.style.animation = '';
        });
        btn.textContent = 'Search';
        btn.disabled = false;
        results.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
      }, 600);
    }

    document.getElementById('zipInput').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') searchStores();
    });

    /* ── Newsletter ───────────────────────────────────── */
    function subscribeNewsletter(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value.trim();
      if (!email) return;

      const form    = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
      const confirm = document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm');

      form.style.opacity = '0';
      form.style.transform = 'translateY(-8px)';
      form.style.transition = 'all .3s ease';

      setTimeout(() => {
        form.style.display = 'none';
        confirm.classList.add('visible');
      }, 300);
    }

    /* ── Category keyboard support ────────────────────── */
    document.querySelectorAll('.category-card').forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          card.querySelector('.category-overlay-btn')?.click();
        }
      });
    });

    /* ── Product add button animation ─────────────────── */
    document.querySelectorAll('.product-add').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        this.textContent = '✓';
        this.style.background = 'var(--teal)';
        setTimeout(() => {
          this.textContent = '+';
          this.style.background = 'var(--green)';
        }, 1500);
      });
    });
  </script>

</body>
</html>

---

## Fresh Pantry — `/app/output/index.html`

**3 files delivered:**

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | Full 1,815-line landing page (63 KB) |
| `robots.txt` | Crawl permissions + sitemap pointer |
| `sitemap.xml` | Single-URL sitemap with 2026-04-24 lastmod |

**All 4 interactions implemented:**

- **Product carousel** — 8 cards, left/right arrow navigation, responsive visible count (4→3→2→1), animated dot indicators, smooth cubic-bezier slide transition
- **Category hover** — 5 cards scale up + green overlay reveals name, description, and "Shop Now →" button; keyboard-accessible
- **Store locator** — Zip input + Search button reveals 3 mock Chicago stores with staggered slide-in animation
- **Newsletter** — Email form fades out and is replaced by a confirmation message on submit

**All content from `source_brief.md` populated:** 8 featured products, 4 seasonal picks, 5 categories, 4 brand highlight stats, 3 store results, full footer nav with 4 columns.

**SEO (from skill):** Full `<head>` with primary/OG/Twitter meta tags, geo tags (US-IL / Chicago), canonical URL, and `GroceryStore` JSON-LD schema with address, hours, coordinates, and social `sameAs` links. Validated property set per skill spec.

**Design:** Brand colors `#2D6A4F` / `#F4A261` / `#FEFAE0`, Nunito headings + Inter body, rounded cards, generous whitespace, floating food-emoji hero grid with CSS animation, fully responsive down to 320px.
